profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Offensive Security
profile.summary: Knowledgeable about the full project life cycle from design to development to delivery.  Extremely diligent developer who creates software with both speed and accuracy.  Extensive experience in finding/resolving bugs and creating performance enhancements.  Works superbly in a team environment.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: At Offensive Security, I have successfully led multiple teams in developing innovative software solutions. My leadership in the enterprise team resulted in a platform that improved product management for administrators. I also architected a CMS that empowered the content team to efficiently release diverse content types. Currently, I am spearheading initiatives to enhance user engagement through an alerting system and improve content creation processes.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the learning team to enhance LinkedIn's learning platform.  
• Developed tools for seamless integration with single sign-on systems and Learning Management Systems (LMS).  
• Focused on improving user experience and accessibility of learning resources.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Led the design and development of a complex migration system for transitioning users from lynda.com to LinkedIn.
• Developed a user-friendly scheduling feature to allow convenient migration timing for users.
• Implemented reminder notifications to guide users throughout the migration process.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless integration within the LinkedIn ecosystem.
• Built monitoring and alerting tools to make sure the transition went smoothly.
• Built administrator tools to quickly handle any outlying issues that may have occurred before or during the transtion.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Developed and enhanced the enterprise platform for lynda.com, enabling administrators to efficiently assign and monitor learning materials.  
• Integrated the platform with Learning Management Systems (LMS) to streamline employee learning behavior management.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure the platform met the diverse needs of enterprise clients.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: At Rapattoni I work on two major software programs relating to association management.  One program is a C#.NET windows application that association staff would use to manage their staff, offices and sub-associations, along with the ability to schedule events and perform billings.  The second program is a web application which allows association members to review their profiles, pay their dues and sign up for classes and events.  The primary technologies I use are C#.NET, Web and WCF Services, SQL Server Databases and HTML tied with ASP.NET, JSON, JavaScript and JQuery

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: At Tri-anim I coordinated with the Information Services department and employees throughout the company, to assess needs, in order to create new, or to improve existing, programs utilized both by staff and management.  I focused on developing software tools that increase the efficiency of the staff by providing accurate and timely information to improve day-to-day operations.  The primary technologies I worked with were C#.NET, Oracle Databases, and Crystal Reports.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I developed human capital management software dealing with performance management (Performance Advisor) and incentive compensation (Compensation Advisor).  My responsibilities included developing accurate estimates of work for given specifications.  I followed this process by then implementing these designs by using an array of tools including Oracle / SQL Server database programming, JavaScript / VBScript programming (within ASP), DLL plug-ins using Visual Basic, and HTML.  I was also often responsible for reviewing and delegating the work of others on my team.
